question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds / 60000.0) as min_minutes,
    AVG(Milliseconds / 60000.0) as avg_minutes,
    MAX(Milliseconds / 60000.0) as max_minutes
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_minutes,
    avg_minutes,
    max_minutes,
    (min_minutes + avg_minutes) / 2.0 as mid_min_avg,
    (avg_minutes + max_minutes) / 2.0 as mid_avg_max
  FROM stats
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 <= b.mid_min_avg THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 <= b.mid_avg_max THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, boundaries b
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.category,
    MIN(tc.duration_minutes) as min_time,
    MAX(tc.duration_minutes) as max_time,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as total_revenue
  FROM track_classified tc
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.category
  ORDER BY 
    CASE tc.category 
      WHEN 'short' THEN 1 
      WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 
      WHEN 'long' THEN 3 
    END
)
SELECT * FROM revenue
